blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–What happens to the second overall pick Titan Ultra supposedly owns in the upcoming PBA Rookie Draft before its franchise was revoked? That is one of the questions the league has to figure out before the annual proceedings take place on Jan. 17 in light of the Giant Risers’ termination from the league for multiple violations.
